jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Overview

APTIM Environmental & Infrastructure, LLC is seeking a junior-level Environmental Scientist on a full-time basis out of our Irvine, CA office to participate in a variety of environmental compliance tasks in support of our RCRA and state hazardous waste, non-RCRA waste, regulated waste, hazardous materials management, stormwater and other environmental compliance media including auditing programs. The successful candidate will prepare technical and compliance reports, conduct technical and regulatory analyses and perform diverse fieldwork, including sampling inspections and audits. Apply expertise to both standard and non-standard situations, ensuring environmental standards are met across projects. Be expected to maintain current knowledge of environmental regulations and emerging developments. This role requires both independent work and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams to ensure compliance and provide clients with practical, science-based solutions. This position will primarily be 50% office and 50% field requiring travel to client facilities conduct environmental compliance reviews/audits and/or gather related data.

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities

Executing and managing various work scopes, while meeting project schedules and budgets.
Collection and interpretation/evaluation of scientific data.
Executing field work within project schedule and budgetary goals.
Use various environmental databases and software to research project/site requirements and document the results in a technical report.
Work independently and as part of a project team and be able to adjust to changing conditions or client requirements.
Adheres to established health and safety policies and procedures and executes work in a safe and conscientious manner.
Understand technical concepts, evaluation results, plans, reports, and ensures conformance to applicable technical standards.
Interfacing with client personnel at a facility level.
Has developing experience, knowledge, and skills in own discipline.
Flexible and willing to support other projects as needed.
Draft technical documents for regulatory agencies and private clients.
Communications with regulatory agencies.
Time management to ensure a quality product is prepared to meet project deadlines.
Applying knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations.
Following defined processes explicitly while also being able to identify and accommodate new or changing scenarios as well as developing processes for new activities.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in environmental science, a core science (such as geology, chemistry, physics, or biology), engineering, or related area required.
Related work experience of 3-4 years.
Must have strong written and oral communication skills.
Must have strong organizational skills.
Strong computer skills required. Must have demonstrated strength and proficiency with Microsoft applications such as MS Excel, MS Word, SharePoint Online, and ability to learn other software applications.
May be asked to work in the field and travel to complete work.
Knowledge of RCRA and state hazardous waste, non-RCRA waste, and regulated waste compliance and national experience required.
Prior experience or training regarding environmental compliance and related federal and state environmental regulations required.
Knowledge of multi-media compliance experience (e.g., stormwater, air quality, storage tanks, etc.) is required
Experience with auditing is preferred.

About APTIM

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.

What You Can Expect From APTIM

Work that is worthy of your time and talent
Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
A voice in making our company better
Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay rate for this position is $35 to $38.46 per hour. Compensation depends on several factors including experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

Employee Benefits

APTIM Envir and Infra, LLC is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/.

Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
Company paid and optional Life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability insurance
Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage
Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law)
401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here:
APTIM 401(k) Guide

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist 1
jobs.description:
Are you driven to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact? At Apex, we’re building more than a consulting and engineering firm—we’re creating a place where your career accelerates, your contributions matter, and your potential is fully realized. We believe your growth is our growth, which is why we invest in your development at every stage of your career. Here, you’ll work on projects that shape communities, protect the environment, and create lasting impact, all while being empowered with the autonomy and flexibility to do your best work.

Fueled by high-quality delivery, exceptional client retention, and strategic acquisitions, Apex Companies continues to rank among the fastest-growing firms in the AEC industry, recently recognized by the Zweig Group for our industry-leading growth. Our success is grounded in strong leadership, a collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

Apex is seeking an entry-level Environmental Field Scientist
that will be responsible for conducting comprehensive on-site environmental assessments at various operational sites to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, as well as internal corporate environmental protocols. This role, utilizing an established checklist, will evaluate facility operations; identify risks; ensure environmental programs are properly implemented; and provide correct actions as needed to support environmental regulatory programs.

This posting is for Portland, OR
and is remote within the Portland Area with 80% travel required.

The anticipated start date is mid-March.

Travel:
Role requires 80% travel to operational sites and must be able to drive to client sites within an approximate 300-mile radius of Portland, OR.

Your Responsibilities As An Environmental Field Scientist

Conduct scheduled and on-call environmental inspections at operational sites to evaluate:
Hazardous waste handling, labeling, and storage
Universal waste and e-waste management
Stormwater and wastewater systems
Spill prevention and control measures
Air emissions, refrigerant management, and equipment compliance
Solid waste management and recycling streams
Chemical storage
Material storage and management

Inspect areas such as loading docks, fuel systems, waste storage areas, material handling areas, and mechanical rooms, etc. for environmental risks.
Review facility documentation including:
Hazardous waste manifests
Emergency response plans
Spill logs and incident reports
Inspection checklists
Training records
Environmental permits
Environmental records
Equipment records
Environmental performance data

Prepare detailed inspection reports using standardized online reporting platforms
Propose corrective actions to address compliance gaps
Perform field work including collecting and processing environmental samples (stormwater, wastewater, air, etc.)

This position is primarily scheduled during standard business hours; however, periodic on-call coverage and off-hours work may be required
. The employee must be willing and able to travel to client sites, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays, as business needs dictate.

Education

BA/BS degree in Environmental Sciences, Environmental Management, Biology, Geology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related discipline.

Experience

0-3+ years of experience conducting environmental inspections, audits, or regulatory compliance assessments.
Experience in distribution, logistics, warehousing, or manufacturing environments strongly preferred.

Skills/Competencies

Knowledge of key environmental regulations (RCRA, EPCRA, Clean Water Act, Clean Air Act, DOT hazardous materials).
Ability to interpret environmental records, manifests, and regulatory documentation.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, audit tools, and reporting platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Comfortable working independently in field settings.
This position is based in Portland, OR and requires frequent travel within a 300‑mile radius. Candidates must be able to reliably travel throughout this region.
Valid driver's license with clean driving record.
This position requires successful completion of medical screening and pre-employment drug testing.
Sponsorship is not available now or in the future.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Medical, dental and vision plan options.
Company-paid life, short, and long-term disability insurance.
401k plan.
Paid time-off and holidays.
Cross-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.
Other perks and incentives.
Working with the best and brightest in the industry.
2,000+ employee national firm with 70+ locations across the US.
